We’re honored to celebrate a global milestone!🎉
 
The Upper Wawa Dam has been recognized as Water Project of the Year at the 2026 Global Water Awards, highlighting projects that are shaping the future of water worldwide.
 
More than a water supply source, the Upper Wawa Dam plays a critical role in strengthening long-term water security in the East Zone of Metro Manila and Rizal Province by augmenting raw water supply and reducing dependence on a single primary source. It also strengthens climate resilience and serves as a vital flood mitigation measure, helping reduce flooding in Rizal and Marikina City by capturing and storing excess rainfall, protecting communities when it matters most.
 
This recognition reflects what collaboration, innovation, and purpose-driven infrastructure can achieve. Maraming salamat po to everyone who made this possible!💙
 
#GlobalWaterAwards #UpperWawaDam #ManilaWater #SerbisyongKatubig

Kilala man sa pagbibigay ng maayos na trabaho, hindi rin papahuli ang Quezon City Public Employment Service Office (QC PESO) sa paghahatid ng exciting summer activities para sa inyong pagkatuto! 📒💡

Sali na sa kanilang mga inihandang programa:

💼 Special Program for Employment of Students and OSY

🖍️ e-Likha Arts Summer Camp

Estudyante ka man, Out-of-School youth, o anak ng migrant workers, may space dito para sa'yo! 🫶🏻

Huwag hayaang puro scroll at tulog lang ang ma-achieve bago ang pasukan. Level up your skills, meet new friends, at galaw galaw din! 🚶🏻‍♀️🧩

Kita-kits sa ating summer ganaps, batang QC! 💫
